notes.title: v1.0.8
notes.content:
Desert Angels was recently demoed at the Seattle Indies Expo, and got a lot of good feedback there. This is a small patch that addresses some of the issues found there:

[list]
[*] Increases the time you can sprint
[*] Minor typo fixes
[*] Attempt to fix an animation error when aiming guns. Sometimes when changing directions quickly, it can still get a little weird. But at least it should be less impossible-contortions weird.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where opening the log from the pause menu did not allow you to scroll on controller
[*] Fixed issue where compendium buttons disabled weirdly on controller
[*] Fixed odd button focusing when selecting menus on controller
[*] Fixed typos
[*] UI tweaks for map markers so it's more difficult to create one accidentally
[*] Added confirmation modal to the ending sequence (so it's harder to accidentally skip parts of the game)
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.6
notes.content:
(Note: the initial public release was 1.0.5, because of some wonky internal versioning before the build.)

This update fixes a freeze that could rarely occur when you attempt to return to title screen while a separate cutscene was queued to be played.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello! 

Steam Next Fest is starting in a few days, and Desert Angels will be participating. With it, we have an updated demo, which has been tuned from all the feedback we received from people who played the previous version. 

There are too many changes to list, but they include:

[list]
[*] A totally revamped map to highlight more of the game mechanics
[*] Quality of life updates for using the map and navigating the story
[*] Dynamic music
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Character expressions in cutscenes
[/list]

Thank you for checking out this game. Any and all feedback is appreciated!
